findings.title: Link-holder write permission on repository and sensitive artifacts
findings.impact: Unauthenticated link holders may access or alter the reported resources; exposure and artifact validity are unassessed.
findings.recommendation: Restrict sharing, preserve audit evidence, classify actual secrets, and rotate/reset affected credentials through controlled procedures.

findings.title: No reconciled single production candidate
findings.impact: A saved patch may not be the file executed by the build or Worker.
findings.recommendation: Create one protected candidate commit, reconcile every patch by path/hash, and separate archival from executable state.

findings.title: Current boundary validator rejects legitimate migration inventory
findings.impact: Integration can fail while isolated validator tests pass.
findings.recommendation: Install a reviewed narrow exception mechanism and test actual current inventory plus negative runtime cases.

findings.title: Public reader uses newest-row freshness rather than completed snapshot
findings.impact: One fresh unrelated record can make stale news appear fresh if partial refreshes coexist.
findings.recommendation: Read only a sealed, complete, approved active snapshot; atomically advance its pointer.

findings.title: Public media bypasses freshness and byte-digest checks
findings.impact: A same-size wrong object is served; rights revocation/freshness semantics differ silently.
findings.recommendation: Verify immutable content-addressed bytes and define explicit approval/revocation/cache rules.

findings.title: Deploy workflow does not establish candidate-wide required checks
findings.impact: A direct deploy path lacks an explicit type-check/test dependency while Next skips build-time type errors.
findings.recommendation: Promote a tested immutable artifact through protected environments and enforce required checks for its exact commit.

findings.title: New runtime/native suites are outside inspected main CI
findings.impact: Hundreds of local tests do not demonstrate repeatable checks on the assembled production candidate.
findings.recommendation: Register all current suites and distinguish blocked platform tests from passed portable tests.

findings.title: Operator console documentation and installed entrypoints diverge
findings.impact: Console documentation names a configuration/wrapper not returned in the inspected folders; API-only entrypoint does not invoke the console.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile console wrapper, assets, config, API contracts and PWA launcher; prove a real Access-authenticated journey.

findings.title: Shared ten-per-minute OTP challenge budget
findings.impact: One club can exhaust another club’s challenge issuance; arbitrary unique phones can consume the shared budget.
findings.recommendation: Adopt measured hierarchical abuse controls and per-club fairness with an explicit global provider-cost ceiling.

findings.title: Session checks do not create cross-database revocation atomicity
findings.impact: A checkout can commit after an identity check and before revocation is observed; downstream money commands need stronger semantics.
findings.recommendation: Define authorization linearization for each command, then implement version/fence or co-located authority as required.

findings.title: Account deletion stops at pending external erasure
findings.impact: Revoking sessions does not complete deletion, retention exceptions or downstream removal.
findings.recommendation: Implement an auditable erasure workflow and user-facing status across every data processor.

findings.title: Payment provenance is not settlement authenticity
findings.impact: Hashes and attestation references cannot establish that actual money moved.
findings.recommendation: Integrate authenticated provider evidence, receiving-account reconciliation and governed exception handling before real allocation.

findings.title: Financial product migration is incomplete
findings.impact: Contribution totals/rewards/referrals, reversals, ticket/shop commands and group workflows are not fully fulfilled by the new allocation core.
findings.recommendation: Complete or explicitly disable each affected business capability; never label allocation-only contributions completed.

findings.title: Historical claims and final consistent backup unproven
findings.impact: Incomplete payment history allows reuse risk; missing media and inconsistent export prevent defensible retirement.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile historical claims, take consistent cutover exports, restore all dependencies and verify object originals.

findings.title: All-D1 suitability is not yet production-proven
findings.impact: Shared global deduplication, trigger-heavy writes, limits and cross-region latency require workload-specific proof.
findings.recommendation: Measure actual D1 transactions and game-day load before final persistence decision; retain global claim authority.

findings.title: Foreign storage authorization has not been evidenced
findings.impact: D1 is not documented as running in Africa; relevant Rwanda personal-data storage requires an authorization assessment.
findings.recommendation: Map data/replicas/backups/processors and obtain valid applicable registrations and foreign-storage authorization before imports.

findings.title: Native adapters are not platform-accepted or integrated
findings.impact: Portable JVM/Swift tests do not prove Android Keystore, Apple Keychain, Dart, Flutter or ten signed club/platform targets.
findings.recommendation: Compile actual hosts, integrate protected credentials/storage, register plugins and execute physical-device journeys.

findings.title: Local state loss leaves unresolved payment attempts unsafe
findings.impact: Uninstall/clear-data can remove local reservations; a new installation cannot infer whether an earlier payment occurred.
findings.recommendation: Add server-authoritative recovery and late/unknown-payment operations; do not clear uncertainty on local reset or expiry.

findings.title: Predict economics remain inconsistent with governing free-entry policy
findings.impact: A 100-FET debit/pool contract must not be promoted by nomenclature changes or flags alone.
findings.recommendation: Record approved economics and territories, align API/ledger/UI/tests, retain historic records and disable unresolved transactional behavior.

findings.title: No completed integrated visual/accessibility evidence registry
findings.impact: Empty registries and structurally passing checks are not design acceptance; payment confirmation is safety-critical.
findings.recommendation: Run accessible real journeys and link approval to exact artifacts, states, clubs and platform versions.

findings.title: Browser/member portal and broad admin migration remain separate
findings.impact: Native-only bearer gateway rejects browser cookies/origin and cannot replace the existing web membership product.
findings.recommendation: Design browser sessions/CSRF and complete role-scoped administration, not a generic consumer-token shortcut.

findings.title: Operational delivery, monitoring and recovery are incomplete
findings.impact: Local outbox acknowledgement does not prove notification delivery; silent disabled logging prevents operational acceptance.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotent consumers, DLQs, privacy-safe telemetry, on-call runbooks and restore drills.

findings.title: Five-club commercial/store readiness is not established
findings.impact: Five configured shells are not ten accepted mobile products; Costa still has explicit identity/payment inputs.
findings.recommendation: Approve each club’s IDs, rights, accounts, routes, bills, submission ownership and platform/territory feature matrix.

findings.title: Governance registers and documents do not reflect one current contract
findings.impact: Seven-row installed inventory, stale offline routes and competing design authority obscure real scope and completion.
findings.recommendation: Normalize unique task/object IDs, source-of-truth hierarchy and decision records; preserve dated evidence without treating it as current.
